digest.en: Asia-Pacific leads the board this hour with U.S., China to set up ‘communication channel’ for AI incidents. Middle East & Africa carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.

articles.title: U.S., China to set up ‘communication channel’ for AI incidents
articles.summary: The two countries established a “U. S.-China Super Intelligence (SI) Dialogue to exchange views on risks and benefits” of AI, the White House said in a fact sheet, noting that their leaders had agreed to use the term SI rather than AI. articles.title: PM Modi’s SCO visit is loaded with expectations on BRICS Summit and UNSC election

articles.title: Tuvalu urges decisive global action as rising seas threaten its future
articles.summary: Climate change remains the greatest existential threat to Tuvalu, Prime Minister Feleti Teo told the UN General Assembly on Friday, warning that the pace and scale of international action are still falling far short of what vulnerable island nations need. articles.title: Nepal PM urges climate justice after ‘Himalayan tsunami’ devastates country
articles.summary: Prime Minister Balendra Shah addressed the Nepal’s Prime Minister Balendra Shah brought a stark warning from the Himalayas to the UN General Assembly on Thursday, saying catastrophic floods that killed at least 1,400 people in his country laid bare the human cost of climate change, and the failure of the international system to protect those least responsible for it. articles.title: Six years on from COVID-19, is the world ready for the next pandemic?
articles.summary: COVID-19 killed millions, shattered health systems and brought the global economy to a virtual standstill. World leaders are meeting Friday to review the lessons learned and cement a new approach to prevention and preparation for the next pandemic. Hopes are high that a World Health Organization-led international agreement can move forward. Six years on from COVID-19, is the world ready for the next pandemic?

articles.title: Yemen violence deepens concerns over child hunger crisis

Yemen violence deepens concerns over child hunger crisis.
